```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

pkgs_bioc <- c("rtracklayer", "GenomicRanges", "GenomeInfoDb", "Biostrings")
pkgs_cran <- c("dplyr", "readr", "stringr", "data.table")

for (p in pkgs_bioc) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install(p)
}
for (p in pkgs_cran) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
}

library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
library(R.utils)
library(Biostrings)
```
```{r}
# Define paths
full_assembly_fasta <- "https://research.nhgri.nih.gov/HydraAEP/download/sequences/hv_aep/HVAEP.genome.fa.gz"
fasta_file <- "HVAEP.genome.fa.gz"

# Download only if not already present
if (!file.exists(fasta_file)) {
  download.file(full_assembly_fasta, destfile = fasta_file, mode = "wb")
}
```
```{r}
aep_fasta_zip<-gunzip("HVAEP.genome.fa.gz")
```

```{r}
aep_fasta<-readDNAStringSet("HVAEP.genome.fa")
```
